---
title: "Clinical Areas"
---

```{python}
#| output: false
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "scripts")
import pandas as pd
from dash_helpers import load, count_bar, heatmap

studies = load("studies.csv")
workflow = load("workflow_long.csv")
target = load("target_long.csv")
```

## Row {height=50%}

```{python}
#| title: Studies by clinical specialty
count_bar(studies["specialty_label"])
```

```{python}
#| title: Studies by workflow stage
count_bar(workflow["workflow_stage_label"], color="#41ab5d")
```

## Row {height=50%}

```{python}
#| title: Studies by evaluation target
count_bar(target["evaluation_target_label"], color="#807dba")
```

```{python}
#| title: "Specialty × workflow stage"
#| classes: mobile-scroll
merged = workflow.merge(
    studies[["record_id", "specialty_label"]], on="record_id"
)
cross = pd.crosstab(merged["specialty_label"], merged["workflow_stage_label"])
heatmap(cross, xlab="Workflow stage", ylab="Specialty")
```
